title: Let's build a Chatbot - User Memory and Personalization (Part 10)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to Part T of the Let's Build a Chatbot in C-Sharp using Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 C# 與 Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的第十部分。

cues.en: We're still doing Blazor Server, but are slowly getting all the features in.
cues.zh: 目前仍使用 Blazor Server，但各項功能正慢慢補齊。

cues.en: And in the last part, we added the user authentication, and we did that essentially to do this video.
cues.zh: 上一部分加入使用者驗證，主要也是為了這支影片。

cues.en: Because now we want to actually add user memory so the user can have personalized context and memories in built-in.
cues.zh: 因為現在要加入使用者記憶，提供個人化上下文與記憶功能。

cues.en: So let's first see it, and then go into the code.
cues.zh: 先看實際效果，再看程式碼。

cues.en: So right now I have a completely empty system, and if I say, hi,
cues.zh: 目前系統完全空白，如果說你好，

cues.en: nothing much happens other than what we normally see, and I can ask, what is my name?
cues.zh: 就只是一般回覆。接著問：我叫什麼名字？

cues.en: And the system don't know.
cues.zh: 系統不知道。

cues.en: Now I will be able to say, my name is Rasmus, I live in Denmark,
cues.zh: 現在可以告訴它：我叫 Rasmus，住在丹麥，

cues.en: and my favorite color is blue.
cues.zh: 最喜歡藍色。

cues.en: If I do this, it will, of course, greet me back with that, but also you can see here in red, it says it added three memories.
cues.zh: 它當然會回應，但也可以看到紅字，表示加入了三項記憶。

cues.en: User name is Rasmus, lives in Denmark, favorite color is blue.
cues.zh: 使用者叫 Rasmus、住在丹麥、最喜歡藍色。

cues.en: So if I take a new chat and says, hi, it will now use this memory in order to be able to say my name,
cues.zh: 開一段新對話，再說你好，它就會透過記憶，稱呼我的名字。

cues.en: and I can say, what do you know about me?
cues.zh: 也可以問：你知道我哪些事情？

cues.en: And it should be able to list off that my name is Rasmus, I'm from Denmark, and my favorite color is blue.
cues.zh: 應該能列出我叫 Rasmus、來自丹麥，以及最喜歡藍色。

cues.en: I can also go in and say, forget my favorite color,
cues.zh: 也可以要求：忘記我最喜歡的顏色，

cues.en: and update that I moved to the UK.
cues.zh: 並更新為我已經搬到英國。

cues.en: If I do that, after its thoughts,
cues.zh: 送出後，經過思考，

cues.en: it will now show that I added live in UK, favorite color is blue,
cues.zh: 可以看到加入了住在英國，顏色仍然被列出，

cues.en: it forgot that I removed that I live in Denmark.
cues.zh: 並移除了住在丹麥。

cues.en: So behind the scenes, it's still a little lamp, sometimes it can do things wrong, but we can tell it here.
cues.zh: 背後畢竟還是 LLM，有時會做錯，但我們可以明確告訴它。

cues.en: Another thing I put in is this custom instructions over here, in that we can go in, for example, and say, speak like a pirate.
cues.zh: 我也加入右邊的自訂指示，例如可以要求：像海盜一樣說話。

cues.en: That is probably something you won't do normally, but you would normally put in that, or here's my preference around this, here's my preference around this, if you want something that are hard and fixed,
cues.zh: 你通常不會真的這樣設定，但可以填入各種偏好，適合那些明確、固定的要求，

cues.en: and not just memories that are being extracted on the fly.
cues.zh: 而不是在對話中自動擷取的記憶。

cues.en: So if we do that and say hi,
cues.zh: 設定後，再說你好，

cues.en: we now speak in pirate speak.
cues.zh: 現在就會使用海盜口吻。

cues.en: So this goes above.
cues.zh: 因此這項指示會優先影響回答。

cues.en: So how is this done, and where is it stored?
cues.zh: 這是如何實作，又儲存在哪裡？

cues.en: So if we look in here, and we look at the changes in the code, let's go through them.
cues.zh: 查看程式碼差異，逐一說明。

cues.en: The first thing we have done is we have made a new model called user personalization, which can handle custom instructions and memories.
cues.zh: 首先建立 UserPersonalization 模型，保存自訂指示與記憶。

cues.en: And for that, we have a new service to do that, where we store them in a user JSON file under a new folder.
cues.zh: 為此新增一個服務，把資料以使用者 JSON 檔案，存放在新的資料夾。

cues.en: And if we look in that folder, it's here.
cues.zh: 資料夾就在這裡。

cues.en: We have the personalized file, which looks like this, where it have...
cues.zh: 個人化檔案長這樣，裡面有……

cues.en: Oh, that's an old one. Let me get rid of that.
cues.zh: 喔，那是舊檔，先刪掉。

cues.en: There we go. So it knows the user's name is Rasmus, and the user lives in Denmark, and the custom instructions.
cues.zh: 好了，現在知道使用者叫 Rasmus、住在丹麥，以及這些自訂指示。

cues.en: So this is all we do.
cues.zh: 主要就是保存這些資料。

cues.en: We could make some GUI that could add memories without doing it via LLM, or remove them again, or reset them, and so on.
cues.zh: 也能製作介面，讓使用者不透過 LLM，直接新增、移除或重設記憶。

cues.en: So that is all this service do.
cues.zh: 這就是服務的全部工作。

cues.en: It can get personalizations and can save the personalizations.
cues.zh: 它可以讀取與儲存個人化設定。

cues.en: That service is, of course, set up in dependency injection, and then we use that personalization.
cues.zh: 服務當然會註冊到相依性注入，再使用這些設定。

cues.en: For the right sidebar, it's quite simple, in that we just put in that new GUI for that, and I put the logic in a code-behind file.
cues.zh: 右側側邊欄很簡單，加入新的設定介面，邏輯放在 Code-Behind。

cues.en: In the chatbot, we have this new area of having the user memories that we saw in red, so we can show it to the user.
cues.zh: Chatbot 則多了這個區域，顯示剛剛紅字的記憶更新，讓使用者看見。

cues.en: That's all depending if you want to show it to the user or not, but it's nice to tell the user what actually was saved, what was not saved.
cues.zh: 要不要顯示取決於需求，不過告訴使用者實際保存了什麼、沒保存什麼，是不錯的做法。

cues.en: Behind the scenes, if we have a look, we use the user personalization service.
cues.zh: 背後則使用 UserPersonalizationService。

cues.en: We save the memory update along the way, and the most interesting parts is, of course, the AI parts.
cues.zh: 沿途記錄記憶更新，最有趣的當然是 AI 部分。

cues.en: First of all, we make a memory extractor agent, and you saw it failed a little.
cues.zh: 首先建立記憶擷取代理程式，剛剛也看到它有點失誤。

cues.en: That's because it's a very, very low model, because I want it to be as fast as possible, but it's a balance of how intelligent it is
cues.zh: 因為使用很小的模型，想盡量提高速度，但也要在模型智慧程度，

cues.en: to get rid of memories and add them again.
cues.zh: 與正確新增、移除記憶之間取得平衡。

cues.en: But it's just essentially getting an instruction saying, look at the user's message and find out new facts.
cues.zh: 基本上只是提供指示：查看使用者訊息，找出新的事實。

cues.en: Facts can be names, places, likes, dislikes, or anything the user would remember this.
cues.zh: 例如姓名、地點、喜好、厭惡，或使用者希望記住的其他事情。

cues.en: Or there might not be any memories.
cues.zh: 也可能完全沒有需要記住的內容。

cues.en: So we make this agent, and then we add an AI contact provider.
cues.zh: 建立代理程式後，再加入 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: If you're not familiar with this, I have dedicated videos about it, but I will explain what it does.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉，我有專門影片介紹，但這裡也會解釋用途。

cues.en: But before we do that, we can just see that it also gets a notification back, and that is the one that gets the updates of a memory.
cues.zh: 在那之前，可以看到還有通知回呼，用來接收記憶更新。

cues.en: And a memory update consists of memories to add and memories to remove.
cues.zh: MemoryUpdate 包含要新增與要移除的記憶。

cues.en: So that takes care of everything but the contact provider.
cues.zh: 除了 Context Provider，其他部分就是這些。

cues.en: But the contact provider is a system in Agent Framework where you can go in and on the fly while a call is being made,
cues.zh: Context Provider 是 Agent Framework 的機制，可以在呼叫過程中，

cues.en: you can provide data upfront before the system, and after the system, you can extract something from the messages
cues.zh: 於呼叫前提供資料，並在完成後，從產生的訊息，

cues.en: that was generated.
cues.zh: 擷取資料。

cues.en: And that's what we do, because we can see here that the personalization system is nowhere to be found in any of the code that we actually call.
cues.zh: 我們就是這樣使用。因此在真正發出呼叫的程式碼裡，找不到個人化系統。

cues.en: That's because it's inside this contact provider.
cues.zh: 因為它被放在 Context Provider 裡面。

cues.en: So let's have a look at the contact provider.
cues.zh: 接著看看 Context Provider。

cues.en: So for the contact provider to work, we give it the memory instructor, and we give what user it is we're logged in as right now, just like we did with all the other things.
cues.zh: 建立時傳入記憶擷取代理程式，以及目前登入的使用者，就像其他功能一樣。

cues.en: We're giving it the user personalization service, and we have this notification so we can update the GUI.
cues.zh: 也提供 UserPersonalizationService，與更新介面的通知回呼。

cues.en: And inside these, you basically have two methods.
cues.zh: 內部基本上有兩個方法。

cues.en: You have a provide AI context and a store AI context.
cues.zh: 一個提供 AI Context，另一個儲存 AI Context。

cues.en: So provide is before sent to the LLM.
cues.zh: Provide 會在送給 LLM 之前執行。

cues.en: Do we want to add anything additionally?
cues.zh: 是否需要額外加入某些內容？

cues.en: In our case, the memories.
cues.zh: 這個例子就是記憶。

cues.en: And after the fact, would you like to, based on what you did that's just been sent, save anything into some custom system?
cues.zh: 完成後，是否要根據剛送出的訊息，把資料保存到自己的系統？

cues.en: In this case, our memory system.
cues.zh: 這裡就是記憶系統。

cues.en: So let's first see how we provide new stuff.
cues.zh: 先看看如何提供新內容。

cues.en: So given that we have some information in a personalization, we can, on the fly, enhance the instructions by giving AI context.
cues.zh: 假設個人化設定中有資料，就能在執行時透過 AIContext，增強指示。

cues.en: So what will actually happen is we have our normal instructions, and these are being put on the fly into those instructions as well.
cues.zh: 也就是原本有一般指示，現在把這些內容也即時加入。

cues.en: So if we have any custom instructions, we simply just add those custom instructions to...
cues.zh: 如果有自訂指示，直接把它們加入……

cues.en: Let me show you.
cues.zh: 示範給你看。

cues.en: Essentially, we are enhancing this instruction in the main agent.
cues.zh: 本質上，就是擴充主要代理程式的這段指示。

cues.en: So we are adding personal instructions, and whatever it says, speak like a pirate, or whatever we have put in.
cues.zh: 加入個人指示，例如像海盜一樣說話，或其他設定。

cues.en: And if we have any memories in, meaning if there's any of these,
cues.zh: 如果有記憶，也就是這些內容不為空，

cues.en: we also just add them to the instructions.
cues.zh: 同樣加入指示。

cues.en: So we add personal memories, being one memory at a time, so it knows all the memories.
cues.zh: 加入 Personal Memories，逐筆列出，讓它知道所有記憶。

cues.en: And then we're just essentially just giving back that context.
cues.zh: 接著回傳這份 Context。

cues.en: Agent framework would take care of putting that together with the other instructions.
cues.zh: Agent Framework 會負責和其他指示合併。

cues.en: So we have essentially instructions, in this case, will be, you are a chatbot answering questions,
cues.zh: 因此這個例子的完整指示是：你是回答問題的聊天機器人，

cues.en: speak like a pirate, user memories are user's name is Rasmus and lives in the UK.
cues.zh: 像海盜一樣說話，使用者記憶包括姓名 Rasmus、住在英國。

cues.en: And if we give that information, we have the AI can respond to, what is my name, and where do I live, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 有了資訊，AI 就能回答我的名字、住在哪裡等問題。

cues.en: And we'll do that in Pirates Week because it's been instructed to do so.
cues.zh: 也會依指示使用海盜口吻。

cues.en: The other part of this is the store, and that's where we actually use the AI.
cues.zh: 另一部分是 Store，這裡才會真正使用記憶擷取 AI。

cues.en: So again, we get the personalizations we already have, and if we have none, we just create a new personalization object.
cues.zh: 同樣先取得既有個人化設定，沒有就建立新物件。

cues.en: Then we go into the chat message that has just been sent to the LM, and get the last message back from us,
cues.zh: 接著查看剛送給 LLM 的 ChatMessage，取得最後一則使用者訊息，

cues.en: meaning if it was, where do I live, or my favorite color is blue, let's say that was what we said.
cues.zh: 例如「我住在哪裡？」或「我最喜歡藍色」，假設剛剛說的是後者。

cues.en: It then makes a little input for the memory extractor, say, you know the following about the user already, and we give it all the memories,
cues.zh: 再為記憶擷取器建立輸入：你已經知道使用者以下資訊，並提供所有記憶，

cues.en: so we tell it, hey, this is what we already know about the user, and we then gave it the instructions,
cues.zh: 告訴它，這些是目前已知的資料，再提供指示，

cues.en: extract other facts that is not any of these.
cues.zh: 要求擷取不在這些內容中的其他事實。

cues.en: We send that, and we use a structured output with a memory update, which had the added memory and the removed memory.
cues.zh: 送出後，以 MemoryUpdate 結構化輸出，取得新增與移除的記憶。

cues.en: And if any memories were added or updated, it could also be that we just said hi, and there's nothing to add or update, or what is the capital of France, or whatever.
cues.zh: 如果有記憶需要新增或更新就處理；也可能只是說你好，或問法國首都，沒有需要新增或更新的內容。

cues.en: And if there's nothing to do, we don't really use any memory, and then spend any time on it.
cues.zh: 沒有變更就不處理記憶，也不再花時間儲存。

cues.en: But if there's any memories, we update the personalization, either add or remove the memories, and we then save the memories and send a notification
cues.zh: 但如果有記憶，就更新個人化設定，新增或移除，再保存並發出通知，

cues.en: that some memories were changed, because if there was no change, we don't need the red text to go there.
cues.zh: 表示記憶已變更。如果沒有變更，就不需要顯示紅字。

cues.en: And that's actually everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 實作內容就是這些。

cues.en: This can just be dropped in in almost any system, and just provide.
cues.zh: 幾乎任何系統都能加入這個元件，提供相關資料。

cues.en: And we can, of course, use bigger models, smaller models, do better prompt instructions in order to actually be able to extract the data.
cues.zh: 當然，可以使用更大或更小的模型，改善提示詞，讓擷取更準確。

cues.en: You could say that only extract data where the user says, remember this, colon, or whatever setup you wanted to do.
cues.zh: 也可以要求，只擷取使用者明確說「記住這件事：」之後的內容，或其他規則。

cues.en: Or you could even take this entirely part away of the store thing, and say it's something that the user should do in a GUI, and then just provide it on the fly instead.
cues.zh: 甚至可以完全移除 Store 這一部分，改讓使用者在介面自行設定，再只於呼叫時提供資料。

cues.en: But that's everything there is to it for user memory.
cues.zh: 使用者記憶的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
